evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies REST endpoint handling in src/rest.cpp
rationale: Prevents spurious and alarming error logs triggered by unauthenticated REST queries for blocks lacking undo data. As noted in the description, requests for disconnected side branches or pruned blocks currently cause `OpenUndoFile failed` to be written to `debug.log`, mimicking disk corruption; checking `BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO` beforehand cleanly returns 404 without log pollution.
